provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, TMC to Launch Compact Sports Car '86' in Japan in April (news release, 2 February 2012)
provenance.notes: Start of the first generation: on sale in Japan from 6 April 2012.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, 86 main specifications (Japan, November 2016)
provenance.notes: Type designation DBA-ZN6 of the first generation. The 2016 update kept the ZN6 code, so it stays in the same generation.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Presents World Debut of the New GR 86 (news release, 5 April 2021)
provenance.notes: The second generation, named GR86, replaces the 86 (GT86 in Europe); developed together with Subaru.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Launches the All-New GR86 (news release, 28 October 2021)
provenance.notes: Start of the second generation: on sale in Japan from 28 October 2021. Used as the end of the first generation, which it replaced the same year.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, GR86 main specifications (Japan, August 2026)
provenance.notes: Type designation 3BA-ZN8 of the second generation, still on sale.
External ids of the make and the model; the GR86 has its own item, not linked here because it is a generation of this model.
